blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) has asked to delay the increase of the passport fee until June 2028 when it begins issuing the next-generation Philippine passports. DFA Secretary Theresa Lazaro proposed the push back in response to government passport printer APO Production Unit’s request to increase the passport fee from P950
